                    ### Question

The patient has a serum creatinine of 2.9 mg/dL and a blood urea nitrogen of 61 mg/dL. A 24-hour urine collection reveals 8.5 grams of protein. A renal biopsy is obtained. Which of the following histologic findings is most likely to be seen upon tissue analysis:?

                    ### Options

opb. Nodular thickening of the glomerular basement membrane
opc. Crescentic proliferation in Bowman’s space
opd. Lymphocytic infiltration of glomerular tufts
ope. Non-caseating interstitial granuloma
